name: Independent calculation reproduction
reviewer_role: Independent second reader with financial-model review experience
objective: Reproduce the base collateral cap without using the workbook result as an input.
required_inputs: 4,000,000 fictional USDC | $1.00 reference price | 2% stress | 50 bps execution cost | 25 bps delay cost | $20,000 fixed cost | 1.25x coverage
review_questions: What available proceeds did you calculate? | What unrounded collateral cap did you calculate? | Which assumption most affects the result? | Did any instruction or label create ambiguity?
pass_criteria: Available proceeds equal $3,870,600 within $1 | Collateral cap equals $3,046,480 within $1 | Reviewer documents independent steps and identifies any ambiguity
required_evidence: Dated calculation steps, reviewer role, result, variance, conclusion, and permission to attribute the review role

name: Unscripted presentation assessment
reviewer_role: Observer who did not build the case
objective: Assess whether the presenter can explain the recommendation, strongest opposing view, evidence boundary, and funding gate without reading a script.
required_inputs: Committee packet | Reviewer brief | Decision view
review_questions: Why is the recommendation $3.0 million rather than $5.0 million? | Why can a conditional recommendation still be blocked from funding? | What is the strongest case for decline? | What evidence would reverse the decision?
pass_criteria: All four questions answered accurately without a script | Fictional inputs and public facts remain clearly separated | Observer records misunderstandings and follow-up actions
required_evidence: Dated observer notes, reviewer role, question-level result, conclusion, and any corrective action

name: Attributed external practitioner feedback
reviewer_role: Authorized external credit, legal, collateral, or portfolio practitioner
objective: Obtain substantive feedback on the decision, control design, or evidence needed to change the recommendation.
required_inputs: Reviewer brief | Committee packet | Relevant supporting artifact requested by reviewer
review_questions: Which decision assumption would you challenge first? | What specific evidence would change your conclusion? | Which control or remedy is operationally unrealistic? | May the reviewer role and response be attributed in the project log?
pass_criteria: Response comes from an actual external practitioner | Reviewer role and permission are recorded accurately | Feedback, change made, and remaining disagreement are logged without embellishment
required_evidence: Dated attributed response or contemporaneous notes, permission status, resulting change, and unresolved disagreement
